technical_overview: Offered at $18.0 for 1.5g, this KoColor EYESHADOW is expertly formulated with Mica, Talc, Silica, Dimethicone, Iron Oxides. Delivering a high-fidelity Barely There color profile (`#F5E0D3`), it leverages advanced engineering via high-purity pigments and volatile carriers. For optimal chromatic impact, apply directly to a clean, prepped surface.
